text:
Sam: Evening handoff — I'm online for the next 8h. TL;DR: light maintenance window tonight, one config tweak deployed earlier, and a watch item for slow tail on route optimizer.

Sam: Changes since day shift:
• patch: config `route-optimizer.max_lookback` lowered to 500ms at 18:05 — no errors.
• deploy: auth-proxy v2.3.1 rolled to staging, will hit prod in the maintenance window at 02:00 UTC.
• infra: kernel patches applied to batch nodes in us-west at 16:20, nodes drained cleanly.

Watchlist (priority order):
1) route-optimizer tail: p99 increased from 220ms -> 410ms around 19:10 on eu-west. If p99 > 400ms for >10m, escalate to infra and start a temporary route-split.
2) auth-proxy rollout: if >0.5% 5xx after 02:00, rollback to v2.3.0.
3) nightly backup: DB snapshot may add IO noise between 23:30-00:15 UTC; expect increased disk I/O on db-primary.

Action items:
• @Rita: please keep an eye on eu-west optimizer lanes and be ready to trim `max_workers` if memory climbs.
• @Evan: verify that auth-proxy healthchecks are included in the canary group before 01:30.
• @Lena: ping support about the backup notification cadence — confirm that it won't trigger customer alerts.

Quick commands / snippets:
• restart optimizer worker: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/route-optimizer --replicas=0 && kubectl -n inference scale deployment/route-optimizer --replicas=3`
• check p99: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/route-optimizer | jq .p99`
• rollback auth-proxy: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/auth-proxy -n ingress --to-revision=3`

Rita: Noted. I saw the tail spike — uploaded a small flamegraph to INF-4012 and added a heap dump. Will DM infra if memory climbs >75%.

Evan: On the auth-proxy canary check — I'll add healthchecks and a pre-rollout smoke task. Will confirm by 01:00.

Lena: I'll contact support about backup noise and ask them to suppress alerts for the snapshot window.

Sam: Two small notes: 1) Dedicated burst is scheduled at 00:30 UTC for scale tests; if burst consumes >40% capacity, I'll enable the soft-throttle policy. 2) If you see an uptick in 429s on embeddings, it's likely due to the optimizer tail; try sending canary traffic to the fallback route `fallback-route-2` as a mitigation.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Maintenance window (auth-proxy prod deploy) scheduled 2026-03-19 02:00-02:30 UTC. This may cause transient 502s.

Rita: I'll keep the fallback ready and script a quick traffic-shift if needed.

Evan: Canary smoke test queued; will post results here.

Lena: Support confirmed suppression for the snapshot window.

Sam: Cool. If nothing else, I'm handing off to Rita for the overnight watch. DM for alerts, thread for context. Good luck. :coffee:

Rita: Taking over. I'll update if anything changes.

Participants: Sam, Rita, Evan, Lena, oncall-bot
